approaches_tried.approach: Naive dupNamespace textual detector (declaration identifier == innermost namespace segment only)
approaches_tried.reason: Only found 10 of the real linter's 14 ChronicleTypes.lean findings -- missed the 4 auto-generated structure field projections + .mk constructor, since those aren't textually declared via a def/theorem keyword.

42 false positives across the tree: a `def _root_.A.B.C ...` declaration escapes every currently-open namespace, so concatenating it with the open-namespace stack (as done for ordinary declarations) produces spurious 'FormalSystem' duplicates for every _root_.-qualified declaration in a file whose own namespace also starts with FormalSystem.

deviations.description: (added, not in the original plan) Fold in the Phase 3 dupNamespace follow-up: replace the static hardcoded count with a live textual check
deviations.reason: Team-lead-directed follow-up from Phase 3 (see that phase's Reasoned Exclusions), folded into this phase per the team lead's own suggestion since it also touches scripts/check-module-invariants.sh. Implemented as an embedded Python block (matching the file's existing C4/C5 embedded-Python convention): tracks namespace/section/end nesting, flags any structure/inductive/def/abbrev/theorem/instance/class whose identifier repeats an open namespace segment, and -- the key precision fix beyond the team lead's own sketch -- accounts for a structure/class's auto-generated field projections and implicit .mk constructor, since those (not the type declaration line itself) produce most of the real linter's findings. Validated iteratively: (1) naive identifier-match-only version found 10/14 (missing the 4 field projections) -- fixed by scanning the structure body for field lines; (2) full-tree run then surfaced 42 false positives from _root_.-qualified declarations incorrectly combined with the open-namespace stack -- fixed by detecting the _root_. prefix and not prepending the stack in that case. Final version: exactly 14/14 matching the real linter, at the same line numbers, over the whole FormalSystem/ tree in ~0.3s, runs even under --no-build. Runs unconditionally (moved outside the RUN_BUILD gate, unlike the env_linter blocking half).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — folded in a team-lead-directed follow-up from Phase 3: replaced C16's static dupNamespace count with a live, validated textual check)*
